citations.section: WHAT WE EXCLUDE / 2. 30 days Waiting Period
citations.quote:
2. 30 days Waiting Period
A waiting period of 30 days will apply to all claims unless:
 You have been insured under this Policy continuously and without any break in the previous Policy Year,
or
 You were insured continuously and without interruption for at least 1 year under any other Indian
insurer's individual health insurance Policy for the reimbursement of medical costs for inpatient
treatment in a Hospital, and You establish to Our satisfaction that You were unaware of and had not taken
any advice or medication for such Illness or treatment.
 If You renew with Us or transfer from any other insurer and increase the Sum Insured (other than as a
result of the application of Cumulative Bonus upon Renewal with Us, then this exclusion shall only apply
in relation to the amount by which the Sum Insured has been increased.

citations.claim: The insured has 32 months of continuous coverage, exceeding the 30-day waiting period and the 1-year exclusion period for specific diseases.
citations.section: WHAT WE EXCLUDE / 3. Hospitalization expense incurred in the first year of operation of the insurance cover on treatment of the
citations.quote:
3. Hospitalization expense incurred in the first year of operation of the insurance cover on treatment of the
following Diseases:
i) Cataract
ii) Benign Prostatic Hypertrophy
iii) Myomectomy, Hysterectomy
iv) Hernia, Hydrocele
v) Fistula in anus, Piles
vi) Arthritis, Gout, Rheumatism
vii) Joint replacement unless due to accident
viii) Sinusitis and related disorders
ix) Stone in the urinary and biliary systems
x) Dilatation and Curettage
xi) Skin and all internal tumors/ cysts/ nodules/ polyps of any kind, including breast lumps unless
malignant, adenoids and hemorrhoids
xii) Dialysis required for rental failure
xiii) Surgery on tonsils and sinuses
xiv) Gastric and duodenal ulcers
However, a waiting period of 1 year will not apply if You were insured continuously and without interruption
for at least 1 year under Our or any other Indian insurer's individual health insurance Policy for the
reimbursement of medical costs for inpatient treatment in a Hospital.
NB: The reduction in the waiting period specified above shall be applied subject to the following:
 We will only apply the reduction of the waiting period if We have received the database and claim
history from the previous Indian insurance Company (if applicable);
 We are under no obligation to insure all Insured Persons or to insure all Insured Persons on the
proposed terms, or on the same terms as the previous health insurance Policy even if You have
submitted to Us all documentation
 We shall consider only completed years of coverage for waiver of waiting periods.

semantic_checks.explanation: The patient was admitted for 96 hours, which exceeds the 24-hour minimum requirement for inpatient hospitalization defined in the policy.
The insured has 32 months of continuous coverage, which satisfies the requirements to waive the 30-day waiting period and the 1-year exclusion period for specific diseases.
The policy defines the normal room sub-limit as 1% of the Basic Sum Insured (500,000 INR), which equals 5,000 INR.
The policy explicitly covers pre-hospitalization expenses for up to 30 days immediately preceding hospitalization.
The policy explicitly covers post-hospitalization expenses for up to 60 days immediately following hospitalization.
The policy limits ambulance charges to 1% of the Basic Sum Insured or 1,000 INR, whichever is less.

The policy requires either registration under the Clinical Establishments Act or compliance with specific minimum criteria (nursing staff, beds, etc.). The case facts do not provide evidence for either.
The calculation correctly identifies the 5,000 INR cap based on the 1% sub-limit rule.
The calculation correctly identifies the 800 INR allowance based on the 1,000 INR cap rule.
